The model knows the API; these are the footguns:\n    22\t\n    23\t- **Page size defaults to A4.** For US Letter set `page: { size: { width: 12240, height: 15840 } }` (DXA; 1440 = 1\u2033).\n    24\t- **Landscape:** pass portrait dimensions and `orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE` \u2014 docx-js swaps width/height internally.\n    25\t- **Tables need dual widths:** set `columnWidths` on the table AND `width` on every cell, both in `WidthType.DXA` (PERCENTAGE breaks in Google Docs).  bold: true,\n      }),\n    ],\n  });\n}\n\nfunction label(text) {\n  return new Paragraph({\n    alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,\n    spacing: { before: 240, after: 100 },\n    children: [\n      new body(text) {\n  return new Paragraph({\n    alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,\n    spacing: { before: 120, after: 120, line: 340 },\n    children: [\n      new TextRun({\n        text,\n        font: 200, after: 200, line: 340 },\n    indent: { left: 500 },\n    children: [\n      new TextRun({\n        text,\n        font: FONT_SERIF,\n        italics: true,\n        size: 24,\n        color: COLOR_INK,\n      }),\n    ],\n  });\n}\n\nfunction bullet(text) {\n  return new Paragraph({\n    alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,\n    spacing: { before: 80, after: 80, line: 320 },\n    indent: { [\n    new Paragraph({\n      spacing: { before: 500, after: 60 },\n      children: [\n        new TextRun({\n          text: number,\n          font: FONT_SANS,\n          size: 20,\n          color:   spacing: { before: 40, after: 240 },\n      children: [\n        new TextRun({\n          text: chineseTitle,\n          font: FONT_SERIF,\n          italics: true,\n          size: 26,\n          color: COLOR_SOFT,\n        }),\n      ],\n    }),\n  ];\n}\n\nfunction divider() {\n  return new Paragraph({\n    alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,\n    spacing: { before: 240, after: 240 },\n pageBreak() {\n  return new Paragraph({ children: [new PageBreak()] });\n}\n\nfunction spacer(size = 400) {\n  return new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: size, after: size }, children: [] });\n}\n\n//
